newHint: The first ten pages ranking for the keyword are read: their shared terms, headings, length and questions.
keywordPlaceholder: e.g. how to choose running shoes
howItWorks: The result page is the one the Keyword Explorer keeps; it is paid once when not fresh. Our own crawler reads the pages, at no cost.
listHint: This project's briefs; open one for its editor and scored pages.
noBriefsText: Enter a keyword to get a brief of what to write, from the first ten results.
checkerHint: Your pages ranking for tracked keywords or getting clicks in Search Console, each scored against its keyword's first ten results.
checkerCost: Each check makes a brief: about $0.002 unless the result page is kept.
noPagesText: Once keywords are tracked or Search Console is connected, your pages appear here with their keywords.
rangeHint: Middle half of the ranking pages: {range}
titleHint: {first} start with the keyword, {year} have a year
shortAnswer: The result page shows a featured answer or an AI overview: open the page with a short, direct answer.
termTip: Used by {share}% of the ranking pages, ~{average} times each
noQuestions: The result page shows no “People also ask”.
noLinks: No fitting page in the latest audit's crawl; run a site audit first.
aiHint: Have Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini write a brief for the writer with your own key.
aiEmpty: Not written yet. The writing rests only on this brief's measures and is asked not to invent figures.
writerCostHint: Paid with your own key; estimated list price
noWriter: Enter your own Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini key to write; writing on credits is not available yet.
editorHint: Write or paste the draft in Markdown; the score updates as you type, free.
draftTitleHint: {n} characters; the ranking pages' median is {median}
draftBodyHint: # H1, ## H2, ### H3; - for lists; | for tables
startWriting: Start writing; the score and missing terms appear here.
noTermsUsed: None of the brief's terms yet.
scoredHint: Score a published page against this brief; see what it lacks and, optionally, AI suggestions.
notMadeTitle: The brief could not be made
notMadeText: The result page could not be had or the pages could not be read. Delete it and try again.
partHelp_placement: The keyword (by word stems) in the title, H1, first 100 words, address and meta description.
partHelp_coverage: Share of the terms most ranking pages use that this text covers.
partHelp_depth: Word count against the ranking pages' median.
partHelp_structure: One H1, as many subheadings as the ranking pages, lists and tables.
partHelp_questions: “People also ask” questions the text answers.
partHelp_media: Images with alt text, and video where the result page shows videos.
partHelp_schema: Schema types the ranking pages use and types that fit the intent.
partHelp_snippet: Title and description lengths that show in full.
partHelp_freshness: Days since the page was last changed (not measured for drafts).
